question: Why did the Lord not teach a thirteenfold scheme for layakala and higher levels?
premises: The Lord did not state a thirteenfold scheme for layakala and similar levels.
One may grant that perceptibility is a property of beings.
Even so, the case of the layakala levels requires a different treatment.
inference: The absence of a thirteenfold teaching reflects the weaker clarity of differentiation at those levels, despite perceptibility being real.
uncertainties: The dual layākalau may refer to two related layakala cases; the exact pair is not explicit here.
plain_english: The Lord did not teach a thirteenfold scheme for the layakala and higher levels. One may grant that perceptibility is a property of beings, but the case of the layakala levels is still different.
